en.t: Then let us bathe together. Come on!

units.source_text: 朝仓漫不经心地说罢，朝通向澡堂的台阶走去了。

en.t: Asakura said it casually, then walked toward the steps leading to the bathhouse.

units.source_text: 我脑子里的东西哗啦啦地全都倾泻出来似的，慌慌张张地紧跟上朝仓。

en.t: As if everything in my head had come pouring out with a rush, I hurried after Asakura in a panic.

units.source_text: 由于意外的羞愧，我好像失落了什么。

en.t: Because of that unexpected shame, I felt as though I had lost something.
